checklist.why: Purpose present; no "to narrow by tag, use filter chips (TaskChips)" line.
No when-not; the README says it switches a list, yet farrowing.death uses it to switch a form between subjects.
Track, buttons and a label with an inline count named and shown.
Three variants exist in practice (lens; two-line lens = TaskLens/.room-tabs; view switch) and none is documented.
Pressed is "not drawn": a gloved tap gets no feedback until re-render; focus is not rendered in the preview.
Buttons are 44px tall inside the two prototype scopes and 38px outside them; floor is 48.
Four segments at most, stated; demos respect it.
Active differs by fill and weight 500 (inside the scopes); weight is a non-colour cue.
Character budget stated; no long-label example.
role=group, aria-pressed and ariaLabel stated; no keyboard row (arrows/Home/End), unlike TaskChips, which wires radioBind.
Base .segment is 38px, radius 10px, 12px type, #fff; the track and active face exist only under :is(.farrowing-phone,.inspection-phone).
No classification, no link to TaskLens or TaskChips.
The preview passes only because it is wrapped in .inspection-phone; rendered bare at 375 it has no track, no active face and 38px buttons (cgate/Segment/bare-unscoped-375.png).

variants.name: lens (states of one list, count inline)
findings: The inspection list "All 7 · Health 4 · Feed 3" is hand-built from .room-tabs, not SentriUI.segment; the preview is the only real call.

variants.name: two-line lens (count under label, sticky, filter button): today TaskLens / .room-tabs
findings: Same job as Segment, different look: a variant, not a separate component.

variants.name: view switch (subject or mode of one sheet)
findings: Only farrowing calls SentriUI.segment; inspection hand-builds .scope-tabs (Pigs/Pens, role=tablist) and .health-tabs (Diseases/Symptoms).

findings.text: Not self-contained: the track, the active face and the 44px height live under :is(.farrowing-phone,.inspection-phone). Outside them (any task-skeleton screen) the segment renders with no track, no visible active state and 38px buttons.
findings.fix: Move the scoped rules onto .st-segment itself (well track, line border, paper + 500 active, min-height control-height) and drop the preview's .inspection-phone wrapper.

findings.text: Targets are 44px at best (preview 112x44, farrowing.death 173x44); the floor is 48.
The README limits Segment to list lenses, but it is used, and hand-copied, as a view switch (Piglets / The sow; Care / Piglet records; Pigs / Pens; Diseases / Symptoms).
findings.fix: Document two variants: lens (states of one list; working pile first, All last) and view switch (2-3 subjects of one sheet; no All, no counts). Replace .scope-tabs and .health-tabs with SentriUI.segment.

findings.text: TaskLens / .room-tabs is the same job with a different look (count under label, sticky, filter button).
findings.fix: Make it the Segment variant "two-line lens" in the one implementation; TaskLens becomes the skeleton's call into it.

findings.text: No pressed feedback; a gloved worker cannot tell the tap landed until the list re-renders.
findings.fix: Add the shared press fill (press token) on :active.

findings.text: No keyboard row; TaskChips already uses radioBind.
findings.fix: State arrows/Home/End and wire radioBind, or state that one tab stop per button is intended.

proposals.name: FilterChips (promote TaskChips to a base component)
proposals.why: Piglet processing's "All 12 · Iron 6 · Dock tail 4 · Castrate 6 · Coccidiosis 6 · Tag 7 · Done 3" is not a Segment variant. Research rule: segmented = a fixed set of 2-5 views of the same data; filter chips = narrowing a list by tags from a dynamic set. Here the set is dynamic (only the jobs due today, 2-7 chips), goes past Segment's cap of 4, scrolls, and each chip is a tag (a job), not a state. It already exists as TaskChips; make it generic (any list narrowed by tag), raise the chip to 48px, and keep the rule "never chips and a lens on one list". Open question for the owner: "Done" is a state, not a tag; it sits in the chip row only because the list cannot also carry a lens.

proposals.name: TaskLens into Segment as variant "two-line lens"
proposals.why: Same job (switch a list between its states), different look; the owner's rule makes it a variant with one implementation.

proposals.name: Segment: view switch
proposals.why: Four screens switch the subject or mode of one sheet; two of them hand-build it.
